blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ABS-CBN Corp. will remain Lopez-led even after the entry of new investors under a P6-billion equity infusion meant to support the media company’s turnaround. Shareholders on Wednesday approved an increase in ABS-CBN’s authorized capital stock and the issuance of additional shares for the investments announced last August.
